verses.text: The daughters of Zelophehad came forward. Zelophehad was the son of Hepher, the son of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, from the clans of Manasseh son of Joseph. His daughters' names were Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.
They stood before Moses, Eleazar the priest, the leaders, and the whole community at the door of the Tent of Meeting, and they said,
"Our father died in the desert. He was not one of Korah's followers who joined together against the LORD. He died because of his own sin, and he had no sons.
Why should our father's name disappear from his clan just because he had no son? Give us land among our father's relatives."
So Moses brought their case before the LORD.
And the LORD said to Moses,
"The daughters of Zelophehad are right. You must give them land among their father's relatives as their own. Give them their father's share.
Tell the people of Israel: If a man dies and has no son, give his land to his daughter.
If he has no daughter, give his land to his brothers.
If he has no brothers, give his land to his father's brothers.
If his father had no brothers, give his land to the closest relative in his clan, and that person will own it. This is a rule and a law for the people of Israel, as the LORD commanded Moses."
Then the LORD said to Moses, "Go up this mountain in the Abarim range and look at the land I have given the people of Israel.
After you have seen it, you too will die and join your people who have died, just as your brother Aaron did.
For when the community argued with me in the desert of Zin, both of you disobeyed my command to show my holiness to them at the water." This was the water of Meribah at Kadesh, in the desert of Zin.
Moses said to the LORD,
"LORD, you are the God who gives breath to all living things. Please appoint a man over this community
who will lead them out to battle and bring them back home, so that the LORD's people will not be like sheep without a shepherd."
The LORD said to Moses, "Take Joshua son of Nun, a man who has the Spirit in him, and put your hand on him.
Have him stand before Eleazar the priest and the whole community, and appoint him as leader while they watch.
Give him some of your authority, so that the whole community of Israel will obey him.

He will stand before Eleazar the priest, who will ask for the LORD's decisions for him by using the Urim. At his command, Joshua and all the people of Israel, the whole community, will go out and come in."
Moses did what the LORD commanded him. He took Joshua and had him stand before Eleazar the priest and the whole community.
He put his hands on him and appointed him as leader, just as the LORD had said through Moses.
